statusText: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. NQ remains weekend-closed; current Tail is low while Gulf energy-route disruption keeps Stress extreme.
recommendation: Mapped policy state: EA_ON. The scheduled 22:00 UTC Globex reopen is the next observation point for gap persistence, retracement depth and cross-asset confirmation.
headline: NQ remains closed as Gulf energy shock keeps reopening stress extreme
body: NQ remains closed before the scheduled Sunday Globex reopen, so current Tail is not supported by live continuation or failed-retracement evidence. The Saudi East-West pipeline outage and fresh Hormuz shipping attack keep energy, inflation and rates stress extreme; Tail can change once actual NQ price discovery begins.
